about_the_game:
Story

After spending many years of training, under the leadership of his guardian Peresvet, the young man Philip returns to his hometown of Turov. He dreams of entering the service of the prince there, becoming one of his vigilantes, and being known as the mighty Brave. But once in his native places, Philip finds a depressing picture: the principality has lost its former greatness, the people are seized with fear, and pagans have settled in the forests, offering prayers to the ancient, long-forgotten Deity and making human sacrifices.

Features:

1. Intuitive passage of game locations (without the need for an interface)

2. Dynamic combat system

3. A really recreated ancient city of Tours, the plot will immerse you in real historical battles of medieval warriors.

4. Exploring a filled and colorful world.

short_description: You are Philip, a young warrior who will have to face the difficulties of life in a city destroyed by Tatar-Mongol raids. But the most important problem is the pagans, hiding in the forests and robbing ordinary people. Save people, return greatness to the principality, become a legend!

Belarusian*, English*, Russian*, French, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
